AccountName.title: AccountName
AccountName.description: Name of the Salesforce Account to link the new Contact to, for example 'Pfizer'. Extracted from the user's utterance. The flow resolves the Account record ID from this name.

Title.title: Title
Title.description: User-provided Contact job title, if supplied.

Email.title: Email
Email.description: User-provided Contact email address, if supplied.

Phone.title: Phone
Phone.description: User-provided Contact work phone number, if supplied.

MobilePhone.title: MobilePhone
MobilePhone.description: User-provided Contact mobile phone number, if supplied.
